name: Random! Cartoons
description: Random! Cartoons is a spin-off of the Nickelodeon animation showcase Oh Yeah! Cartoons. Produced by Frederator Studios and Nickelodeon Animation Studios for the Nicktoons Network, it premiered on December 6, 2008.

videos.title: Solomon Fix
videos.overview: Overly helpful teddy bear Solomon Fix gets assigned ownership to an edgy tween boy.

videos.title: MooBeard the Cow Pirate
videos.overview: Captain MooBeard and his first mate, Sailor Bird, are out to find treasure on the Island of Hookamookapookalap. When the evil ninja ducky Dark Blade of Fire steals their map, they must race to finish and claim what is rightfully theirs!

videos.title: Two Witch Sisters
videos.overview: Twin witch sisters cause magic-induced havoc at a park.

videos.title: The Finster Finster Show: Store Wars
videos.overview: The Finsters battle anthropomorphic frozen chickens in the supermarket.

videos.title: Adventure Time
videos.overview: Pen, a human boy, and his best friend Jake, a dog with magical powers, have to rescue Princess Bubblegum from the antagonistic Ice King.

videos.title: Mind the Kitty
videos.overview: Three teens have to babysit a psychotic kitten girl.

videos.title: Ivan the Unbearable
videos.overview: A clumsy Viking gets hiccups that causes destruction.

videos.title: Boneheads
videos.overview: Roccos and Bone search for babanas.

videos.title: Tiffany
videos.overview: A doll must help her friend overcome a fear of horses.

videos.title: Call Me Bessie!
videos.overview: A peppy, fun-loving cow takes her worrisome elephant neighbor out for a day of scuba-diving.

videos.title: Teapot
videos.overview: Two African-American kids who are fans of rap music are going to meet a famous rapper.

videos.title: Hornswiggle
videos.overview: A crazy rhino meets his hero, Zantar. He tries to help but physically hurts him.

videos.title: Hero Heights
videos.overview: In a town where everyone's a superhero, two best friends fight over the new girl in town.

videos.title: Yaki and Yumi
videos.overview: A bat and a dragon participate in a dance competition.

videos.title: Gary Guitar
videos.overview: A guitar tries to make the perfect picnic for his girlfriend, a violin.

videos.title: Krunch and the Kid
videos.overview: A monster named Krunch has trouble performing on a TV show after his pet frog dies.

videos.title: Bradwurst
videos.overview: A grumpy sausage sabotages his friends' party.

videos.title: Dr. Froyd's Funny Farm
videos.overview: Dr. Froyd needs someone to test out a science experiment, but none of the animals on his funny farm want to.

videos.title: The Bravest Warriors
videos.overview: Four human teens, Chris, Beth, Wallow and Danny, save the brain dogs from the tickle monster in outer space.

videos.title: The Dangerous Duck Brothers: Saps at the Wheel
videos.overview: Two ducks want to break a dangerous record.

videos.title: Sparkles and Gloom
videos.overview: Sparkles and Gloom, two daughters of a handsome prince and an evil witch, have their powers switched before the talent show at the Geevil School, the good and evil school, where good and evil are best friends.

videos.title: The Infinite Goliath
videos.overview: The Infinite Goliath, a super villain released on parole, moves into a neighborhood.

videos.title: Kyle + Rosemary
videos.overview: A geek and a goth who play MMORPG games must break their shells to be together.

videos.title: Garlic Boy
videos.overview: An anthropomorphic garlic with a healing tonic wants to do good for folks.

videos.title: Flavio
videos.overview: An Italian goat wishes to be an inventor.

videos.title: SamSquatch
videos.overview: A cryptid hunter finds a Bigfoot named SamSquatch.

videos.title: Girls on the GO! - First Date
videos.overview: Katerina Metropolis is a hopeless romantic teenager who daydreams about meeting the perfect boy. But how will she manage after she winds up on the worst date of her life?

videos.title: Victor the Delivery Dog
videos.overview: Victor has to make deliveries before dinnertime.

videos.title: Bronk and Bongo in: Losing Patients
videos.overview: Bronk and Bongo are a couple of dogs who are mistaken to be world-famous German doctors in this madcap, zany romp.

videos.title: Thom Cat
videos.overview: A talking cat helps a troubled girl from a bully.

videos.title: Sugarfoot
videos.overview: A boy who is a fan of cowboys and dinosaurs goes to a field trip to a museum with both of his interests while dealing with a bully.

videos.title: Dugly Uckling's Treasure Quest
videos.overview: Dugly Uckling and his ragtag crew are out to solve the mystery of the Golden Bobblehead. Battling their way through the swamp, jungles, and killer mosquitoes, they come to a place where only Dugly's nonsensical logic can save the day.

videos.title: Dr. Dee and Bit Boy
videos.overview: Two kids and a scientist in a dog suit stop a corporation from creating a donut addiction.

videos.title: Super John Doe Jr.
videos.overview: The son of a superhero, who has no powers, decided to take his dad's place and fight against his nemesis.

videos.title: Six Monsters
videos.overview: Adventures of six monsters in middle school presented in different styles of animation (traditional, CGI, Flash, and digital ink and paint).

videos.title: Ratzafratz!
videos.overview: Three hungry rats must escape a security guard.

videos.title: Squirly Town
videos.overview: A sly hyperactive squirrel takes his germaphobe strait-laced friend on an adventure to clear his aching head.

videos.title: Fanboy
videos.overview: Superhero obsessives Fanboy and Chum Chum head to their local convenience store for a Frosty Freezy Freeze and end up unleashing an ice monster.

videos.title: HandyCat in Bees-ness As Usual
videos.overview: Jolly handyman HandyCat and his dog Drillbit help an old lady remove a swarm of bees from her backyard tree.
